## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `microsoft-teams-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Register an application in Microsoft Entra ID

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [Microsoft Entra admin center](https://entra.microsoft.com). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Entra ID › App registrations and click New registration. -->
3. <!-- manual: Enter a name of your choice and select the account types appropriate for your organization. For delegated (refresh_token) access, add a Redirect URI under the Web platform — this is where the sign-in flow returns the authorization code (a Microsoft-hosted page such as https://jwt.ms is a convenient choice). The Web platform is required for the delegated flow because the connector redeems the code using a client secret (a confidential-client flow). Click Register. -->
4. <!-- manual: On the app's Overview page, note the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID — both are needed when configuring the connector. -->

## Step 3: Add Microsoft Graph permissions

1. <!-- manual: In the registered application, go to API permissions › Add a permission › Microsoft Graph. -->
2. Select **Delegated permissions** (for `refresh_token` auth) or **Application permissions** (for `client_credentials` auth), then add the permissions your use case requires — each operation's required scope is listed in its Microsoft Graph API reference. For the delegated flow, also include `offline_access` so the token response includes a refresh token. Click **Add permissions**.
3. <!-- manual: add the permissions your use case requires — each operation's required scope is listed in its [Microsoft Graph API reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/overview) -->
4. <!-- manual: Back on the API permissions page, click Grant admin consent for \ and confirm Yes. -->
5. Confirm every permission now shows **Granted for \** in the **Status** column.

## Step 4: Create a client secret

1. <!-- manual: Go to Certificates & secrets › New client secret, add a description and an expiry, and click Add. -->
2. <!-- manual: Copy the secret Value immediately — it is shown only once. The Secret ID shown next to it is just a label for the secret, not a credential. -->
